title: Scalar Kummer Chern realization before direct image
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and n a nonnegative level with finite coefficient quotient A=ULift(O_E/l^(n+1)). Let X,S be Noetherian schemes, l invertible on S, and e:X≅P¹_S. Fix Chern data cX with FiniteChernNormalization [def-sp-tower-class-finite] and arbitrary constant- and root-section normalized CoefficientCoordinates on X [def-sp-p1-coefficient-coordinates]. Let H be ordinary pullback along e followed by intrinsic realization. Then there is an isomorphism t from Ev_X(line(cX)[2]) to H(A_P¹(1)[2]) carrying the evaluated first Chern class of e*O(1) to the comparison image of the specified etale Kummer Chern class of O(1), pulled back along e. The source comparison is the fixed normalized coefficient coordinate followed by the inverse ordinary unit pullback along e [lem-sfb-finite-p1-coefficient-adjunction-coordinates]. The ordinary positive class is the one defining (G2) [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. This is an equality on X before any direct-image adjunct and involves no tower base, geometry, or coefficient pullback. The separately proved ordinary adjunct identity identifies this positive class with the second component of the specified G2 map, using only the decomposition component definition and the site-comparison mate.

proof.text: Use the explicit finiteP1KummerCoordinate, the composite of evaluation, the supplied normalized coefficient line coordinate, shift comparison and pullback along e. No witness is selected from a bare Nonempty isomorphism theorem.

Specialize FiniteChernNormalization to the pulled-back hyperplane class. Apply the normalized boundary transport theorem with the canonical comparison and ht=rfl. This gives the required realization equation and the existential witness.

theorem finiteP1_kummer_chern_realization
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (hc : FiniteChernNormalization l E cX)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ) [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))}
    (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX) :
    ∃ t : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).obj ((line l E cX)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
      (finiteOverRealization l E n e).obj
        (geoP1Twist (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
          (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) (ProjectiveLine S) 1 2),
      (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).map
          (firstChern l E cX (Scheme.Pic.mapHom e.hom (hyperplanePic S))) ≫ t.hom =
        (finiteOverUnitCoordinate l E n e c).hom ≫
          (finiteOverRealization l E n e).map (finiteP1PositiveClass l E S hS n)
